question: If $A=[a_{ij}]$ is an identity matrix, then which of the following is true ?
explanation:
**Step 1:** By definition, an identity matrix is a square matrix in which elements on the main diagonal are all equal to 1, and all other elements are equal to 0.

**Step 2:** This condition is expressed mathematically as $a_{ij} = 1$ when $i = j$ and $a_{ij} = 0$ when $i \neq j$, matching option D.

options.A: $a_{ij} = \left\{ { 0, \text{ if } i = j \atop 1, \text{ if } i \neq j } \right.$
options.D: $a_{ij} = \left\{ { 0, \text{ if } i \neq j \atop 1, \text{ if } i = j } \right.$
